script:
$root = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\SD\VID_02D0&PID_A9A6&FN_1'
foreach ($i in Get-ChildItem $root) {
  $k = Join-Path $i.PSPath 'Device Parameters'
  if (-not (Test-Path $k)) { New-Item $k -Force | Out-Null }
  Set-ItemProperty $k -Name BootFw -Value 1 -Type DWord
  Set-ItemProperty $k -Name ProbeState -Value 0 -Type DWord
  "armed: $($i.PSChildName)  BootFw=" + (Get-ItemProperty $k).BootFw
}
$d = Get-PnpDevice | Where-Object { $_.InstanceId -like 'SD\VID_02D0&PID_A9A6&FN_1*' } | Select-Object -First 1
"restarting: " + $d.InstanceId
pnputil /restart-device $d.InstanceId | Out-String
